Talata & Co., Friday basketball, then dinner together

Men and women, 18 and up, every level. We play at Svanemøllehallen, then sit down together at the café in the hall. Come new to the city, come back after years off, or come to meet people. Plenty start knowing nobody.

Ages
18 and up, men and women
When
Fri 18:30 to 20:00 at Svanemøllehallen from 23 Oct
Where
Svanemøllehallen, Østerbrogade 240, 2100 København Ø
Price
2.000 kr per half-season
Book a trial

The people

Talata & Co. is a game and a group. People from all over Copenhagen, all kinds of jobs, Danes and internationals. You make friends on the court and contacts at the table after.

After the game

We eat together at the café in Svanemøllehallen. Members get:

  • A member discount on food and drinks at the café
  • A drink on the house on launch night, Friday 23 October
  • A drink on the house on the last Friday of every month

Coffee, tea or a drink. Your pick.

How it runs

A player captain runs the session and Coach Deng drops in. Warm up, a few drills, then games. No league and no weekend games.

It suits you if you played years ago and want back in, if you never played on a team, or if you just moved to Copenhagen and want people to play with.

Want league basketball?

Talata Men play 3. Division Herrer Øst, with a tryout. Talata Men.
